title: [review] E=1 TransitInfo parse relaxation: non-root nodes now forward signed E=1 DAOs (wasted airtime, uncovered behavior change)
description: P2, wave-5 review. message.rs:1246-1249 makes E=1 parse (previously aborted parse). dao_parents_for_source (lichen-node/src/routing/router.rs:1151-1155) consumes TransitInfo without checking external; previously node.rs:597-601 refused to forward E=1 transits; now non-roots forward signed E=1 DAOs toward a root that rejects them (routing.rs:1504) - wasted airtime on LoRa, behavior change with no test. Fix: if transit.external { return None; } in dao_parents_for_source, or add a test documenting the new forwarding behavior as intended.
